sar.narrative: On 2016-12-02, card C10434-K1 belonging to customer C10434 was identified with unauthorized activity. Flagged transaction 3506725 for $1000.03 exhibited pattern characteristics of card_not_present_new_device. Investigation revealed 1 suspicious transaction(s) totaling $1000.03 USD. Activity originated via online channel using device profile (Windows | Windows 10 | edge 16.0 | 1366x768). The cardholder did not authorize this activity and confirmed no legitimate relationship with the transactions. Evidence indicates intentional card compromise. The financial institution has blocked card C10434-K1 and placed all associated accounts under enhanced surveillance.
